newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zaire ambassador who killed boys to return - Mobutu.
newsitem.headline: Zaire ambassador who killed boys to return - Mobutu.

text.p: Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko said on Tuesday his ambassador to Paris, accused of running over and killing two French boys on a pedestrian crossing on the Riviera, is to return to France, presumably to face charges.
"I am telling you now that the ambassador will be here before the end of the week," Mobutu told French television stations.
The African leader, speaking at his French retreat at Roquebrune Cap-Martin on the French Riviera, gave no further details.
But aides told reporters that ambassador Ramazani Baya, who left France several weeks ago after taking advantage of his diplomatic immunity, had been relieved of his functions.
France has vowed to bring Baya to justice after he was accused of driving through a pedestrian crossing at more than twice the legal speed limit, hitting the teenagers.
Mobutu, who is resting on the Riviera following surgery for cancer, is a close ally of France in Africa.
